verdict.rationale: Jules lets a developer steer an in-progress task: it notifies when input is needed, and the developer can send messages to the agent through the API, approve plans, and give feedback so the agent continues. That covers redirecting the work from the browser or API. However, nothing shows a developer taking over the cloud VM session in their own editor or terminal to finish the work by hand, and one user reports there is no stop button to interrupt a looping agent. missing for 10: handoff of in-progress VM state to a local editor or terminal, manual takeover to finish the work, interrupt/stop control, independent corroboration of mid-task redirection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can take over an in-progress agent task in my editor, terminal, or browser to finish or redirect the work

citations.quote: You’ll be notified when the task completes or needs your input.
To send a message to the agent:
Please review the work done so far and provide feedback for Jules to continue.
You can review and approve it before any code changes are made.
